name: mark_note_as_cash_pay
description: Adds 'Mark as cash pay' / 'Unmark as cash pay' to the note header dropdown on billable notes. Marking labels the note's claim Cash Pay and moves it to a configured Cash Pay claim queue. Off until CASH_PAY_ENABLED is true; the queue must already exist.

protocols.description: Note header dropdown item that labels the claim Cash Pay and moves it to the Cash Pay queue
Note header dropdown item that removes the Cash Pay label and returns the claim to coding
Moves a Cash Pay-labeled claim to the Cash Pay queue when it enters NeedsCodingReview
